thread:
anna: Quick announcement — we've decided to extend the sunset for the Legacy SDK 2.x/3.x deprecation window. new EOL: 2026-09-30 (was 2026-03-31). :spiral_calendar:
anna: Reason: high customer dependency & several big enterprise migrations still in progress; we heard the ask for more runway.
maria: Thanks — docs team, please hold off hard redirects to new SDK docs until we finish compatibility guide and migration CLI docs. I'll own this.
jake: Engineering note: we'll ship a compat shim in SDK v4.2 that exposes a `compatMode: true` option and a small opt-in parameter mapping layer. This buy-time shim is not intended long-term but should unblock most integrators.
anna: Correct — compatMode will be opt-in (off by default). We will not backport it to older SDKs. We'll provide a migration CLI and a checklist.
migrator-bot: new release published: redwood-sdk-migrator v0.9.0 — run `redwood-migrate --scan` to generate suggested changes. https://internal.redwood.dev/migration-cli
anna: Migration timeline and deliverables: 1) compatibility shim in v4.2 (ETA 2026-04-15) 2) migrator CLI docs + sample PR patches (available now in staging) 3) docs migration playbook + quickstart snippets (maria delivered 2026-05-01) 4) targeted outreach to top 50 integrators (customer success) by 2026-06-15.
oliver: Support playbook: add a canned response for customers asking about EOL extension and provide the migrator CLI link. We'll also create a short runbook for common failures (auth mappings, timeout param changes).
karen: Engineering teams: please flag any internal services still using legacy SDK on the infra inventory by EOD Friday. We'll prioritize automations for the top 10.
maria: Docs snippets to include (draft):
```
# enable compat mode
from redwood import Client
client = Client(api_key=os.getenv("REDWOOD_API_KEY"), compatMode=True)
# or CLI patch suggestion
redwood-migrate --apply --files path/to/service
```
maria: I'll also add a section "When to use compatMode vs migrate" with examples and perf caveats. CompatMode will have a ~5-10% latency cost on some paths.
jake: Dev note: we'll add telemetry labels so we can see who uses compatMode (`compat_mode=true`) — opt-in telemetry only, per privacy policy. No payloads will be captured.
anna: Action items: - Maria: publish compatibility guide draft by 2026-05-01 - Jake: PR for v4.2 compat shim by 2026-04-10 - Support (Oliver): canned responses + runbook by 2026-04-20 - CS: outreach plan by 2026-06-01
karen: For any migration blockers (native mobile, on-prem air-gapped installs), escalate to me and I'll route infra support.
anna: I'll post a short announcement to #general and update the public deprecation page once docs are live. If anyone has customer-facing wording suggestions, drop them here.
maria: Draft blurb for public page: "We are extending the sunset date for the Legacy SDK to 2026-09-30 to give customers additional migration time. We’re providing an opt-in compatibility mode and a CLI to help automate common changes. See internal migration guide (link) for details."
anna: Looks good. small tweak: add link to FAQ and contact for white-glove migration support.
jake: From eng side — note that compatMode will not emulate deprecated telemetry behavior (we're not restoring old sampling). Mention that in docs.
oliver: Got it. I'll add the FAQ entry about telemetry differences.
anna: Thanks all. Will follow up with the public announcement draft and a pinned docs checklist. :thumbsup:
